div.style: color: rgb(42, 42, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
snapshot · src/sources/
reconcile both · deriveMode → TeeML · TeeTLS · standard

div.style: color: rgb(95, 67, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
plan · probes/plan.ts — pure, offline, free
target = (address, model) · negotiate params · 3× price ceiling · group by canonical_id

div.style: color: rgb(95, 67, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
roster · probes/epoch-run.ts + roster-lock.ts
multi-provider groups only · fit whole groups to budget · lock the series

div.style: color: rgb(95, 67, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
probe · probes/suite.ts + router-client.ts — the only step that spends
15 fixed probes × N services · pinned · 1 call, no retry
budget held before the call · pin verified after · transcript .jsonl per call

div.style: color: rgb(95, 67, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
divergence · probes/divergence.ts
TeeML reference, else peer / majority
minus the measured noise floor
unmeasurable → 0xFFFF, never 0

div.style: color: rgb(95, 67, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
aggregate · probes/aggregate.ts
p50 · p95 · errorRateBps
nearest-rank, integers only
our faults ≠ their errors
under 5 samples → no number

div.style: color: rgb(42, 42, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 900px; text-align: center;

span.p:
epoch record · aggregate.toMeasurements() + chain/writer.ts
7 integers per service · insufficient services dropped, never zero-filled
